allow: PowerShell($release = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json" | Where-Object { $_.lts } | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output "LTS version: $\($release.version\)")

PowerShell($installDir = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\nodejs"; Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\\node.zip" -DestinationPath "$env:TEMP\\node_extracted" -Force; $extracted = Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\\node_extracted" | Select-Object -First 1; Move-Item $extracted.FullName $installDir -Force; Write-Output "Installed to $installDir"; & "$installDir\\node.exe" --version; & "$installDir\\npm.cmd" --version)
